summary: Iran's military leadership is actively preparing for prolonged conflict, restructuring command and accelerating missile production while IRGC generals held secret discussions with proxy militias about expanding the war during the ceasefire. The IDF conducted targeted strikes against PIJ and Hamas operatives in Khan Younis and Nuseirat, while Israeli artillery shelled areas in southern Lebanon including Talousa and Wadi Salouqi. A coalition of eight nations including Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Qatar issued a joint statement condemning Israel's rejection of the Trump roadmap for Gaza, as Trump's 60-day deadline for Iran reportedly expires.

points: Iran's leadership has spent the past two months restructuring military command, accelerating missile production, and preparing for prolonged conflict despite continuing negotiations with Washington, according to a report. This indicates a dual-track approach where Tehran maintains diplomatic engagement while simultaneously building military readiness for an extended confrontation. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6346)

Senior IRGC generals held secret discussions with commanders of Hezbollah, the Houthis, and pro-Iranian militias during the ceasefire about expanding the war and increasing the cost for the United States. Quds Force commanders conducted online conference calls with proxy leaders to coordinate escalation strategies, undermining the diplomatic track. (Source: @asafroz/52508)

Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman stated there is no 60-day period in the memorandum of understanding, claiming Iran never actually began negotiations because the US started widespread violations weeks after signing. He emphasized that Iran's armed forces are monitoring all movements and developments with full alertness. (Source: @N12chat/222228)

The IRGC stated that the Strait of Hormuz will be reopened when the United States complies with its obligations under the Islamabad agreement, and that proposals for a new waterway with Oman relate to the post-war period. (Source: @naya_foriraq/87932)

Iran's army commander-in-chief, Major General Amir Hatami, announced a $30,000 reward for the capture or killing of any American force by an Iranian national, with double the amount offered for women, during a Sunday ceremony in Tehran. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6337)

Iranian Parliament speaker claimed the scope of fire used by the enemy against Iran exceeds that used during the entire Vietnam War, but stated the Iranian people have proven resilient and strong. (Source: @yediotnews25/134000)

The Iranian parliament passed a law criminalizing contact with foreign media, with penalties of six months to two years imprisonment for interviews with outlets deemed hostile, and up to five years during crisis conditions. The law designates US and Israeli media as hostile and restricts scientific cooperation with foreign institutions. (Source: @VahidOnline/77886)

The IDF struck two terrorists from PIJ and Hamas — one in the Khan Younis area and one in the Nuseirat area of the Gaza Strip. The terrorists were advancing terror plots and were attacked from the air to remove the threat. IDF forces in Southern Command are deployed in the area in accordance with the agreement. (Source: @idf_telegram/24910)

The IDF carried out a strike targeting a terror operative in the southern Gaza Strip, with Palestinian media reporting the strike hit a tent in the Khan Younis area, injuring several people. Further details were expected to be provided by the IDF. (Source: @manniefabian/58978)

Nahal Brigade 931 conducted a training exercise simulating the northern terrain, led by a new battalion commander after spending two months in southern Lebanon. The 18-hour exercise included encounters with ARN, simulated terrorists, and three deployment scenarios, while the brigade is also engaged in operational activity in Judea and Samaria. (Source: @idf_telegram/24911)

Dozens of Israeli military vehicles, accompanied by heavy bulldozers and other machinery, raided the Palestinian village of Qalandia, north of occupied Al Quds, amid concerns that Israeli forces are preparing to demolish Palestinian structures in the area. (Source: @presstv/203085)

Ma'ariv reports that the United States considers Iran the main arena and is demanding Israel de-escalate and avoid escalation in Gaza and Lebanon. The IDF is now required to balance protecting its soldiers against Hezbollah and Hamas field challenges with significant American pressure to avoid escalation. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385202)

Israeli political tensions continue: Lieberman stated he will not join a 58-seat minority government, calling it unacceptable. A poll shows Eisenkot and Netanyahu tied with 23 mandates each, with Bennet gaining strength. (Source: @amitsegal/63921)
Netanyahu did not deny any publication regarding his concern about Goutlieb during a discussion that took place. (Source: @amitsegal/63914)

The IDF struck a terrorist from the PIJ in the Khan Younis area and a terrorist from Hamas in the Nuseirat area of the Gaza Strip. Both were advancing terror plots and were attacked from the air. IDF forces in Southern Command remain deployed in accordance with the agreement and will continue to act to remove any immediate threat. (Source: @idf_telegram/24910)

The IDF carried out a strike targeting a terror operative in the southern Gaza Strip. Palestinian media reports that the strike hit a tent in the Khan Younis area, injuring several people, with further details expected from the IDF. (Source: @manniefabian/58978)

Dozens of Israeli military vehicles, accompanied by heavy bulldozers and other machinery, raided the Palestinian village of Qalandia, north of occupied Al Quds, amid concerns that Israeli regime forces are preparing to demolish Palestinian structures in the area. (Source: @presstv/203085)

Hamas welcomed the joint statement by the foreign ministers of the UAE, Qatar, Jordan, Indonesia, Pakistan, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Egypt, which condemned Israel's rejection of the roadmap to complete implementation of President Trump's plan and held Israel responsible for obstructing efforts to end the war. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385194)

Hamas praised the statement's emphasis on the necessity of full and immediate implementation of the roadmap, the continued active role of the United States and the Peace Council and mediators in ensuring implementation, and preventing Israel from disrupting or reneging on its obligations. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385194)

Multiple countries — Egypt, Jordan, UAE, Qatar, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan — issued a joint statement against Israel, holding it responsible for disrupting peace efforts in Gaza and stating it threatens Trump's intensified efforts to end the war. (Source: @yediotnews25/133991)

Israeli military vehicles entered the town of Bani Huyan with explosions occurring in the town, indicating an active ground incursion or raid operation in southern Lebanon. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385208)
Artillery shelling targeted Talousa and Wadi Salouqi in southern Lebanon, indicating continued active artillery engagement along the border area. (Source: @redlinkleb/37014)

Israeli forces again carried out artillery shelling targeting the outskirts of Talousa and Wadi Salouqi, confirming sustained artillery activity in this sector of southern Lebanon. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385203)

Nahal Brigade 931 returned from two months of operational deployment in southern Lebanon and immediately conducted an 18-hour training exercise simulating the northern terrain, led by a new battalion commander. The exercise included encounters with ARN, simulated terrorists, and three deployment scenarios. (Source: @idf_telegram/24911)

Ma'ariv reports that the US is demanding Israel avoid escalation in Lebanon, requiring the IDF to balance protecting soldiers against Hezbollah's field challenges with American pressure to prevent broader escalation. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385202)

The Trump administration used Iraqi Kurdish President Nechirvan Barzani as a secret backchannel to the IRGC in May, after US negotiators questioned whether Iranian officials actually spoke for the IRGC. Barzani arranged a call with IRGC commander Ahmad Vahidi, who backed the negotiators. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6334)

Trump praised Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan for recently signing a joint defense agreement in Mecca, stating it demonstrates Middle East cohesion and how nations can finally defend themselves more effectively. He called it a large, bold, and important first step. (Source: @naya_foriraq/87923)
An emergency alert was issued in the Jazan region of Saudi Arabia, though specific details about the nature of the alert were not provided. (Source: @shin_persian/8977)

Eight nations — Egypt, Jordan, UAE, Qatar, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan — issued a joint statement condemning Israel's rejection of the roadmap for Trump's plan, holding Israel responsible for obstructing peace efforts and achieving security and stability in the region. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385194)

The joint statement by the eight countries emphasized the need for full and immediate implementation of the roadmap, the continued active role of the United States and the Peace Council and mediators, and preventing Israel from disrupting or reneging on its obligations and proceeding with the second phase requirements. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385194)

sections.threat_assessment: Iran is pursuing a dual-track strategy of diplomatic engagement and military preparation, with IRGC generals coordinating with proxy militias including Hezbollah and Houthis to expand the war while Tehran restructures command and accelerates missile production. The announcement of bounties on American forces by Iran's army commander, combined with the denial of the 60-day negotiation period, signals a deteriorating diplomatic environment. Israeli artillery operations in southern Lebanon near Talousa and Wadi Salouqi, alongside ground incursions into Bani Huyan, indicate active low-intensity conflict that could escalate if either side miscalculates.
sections.regional_response: A coalition of eight nations including Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Qatar, UAE, Jordan, Indonesia, and Pakistan has issued a joint statement condemning Israel's rejection of the Trump roadmap, signaling coordinated regional diplomatic pressure. Trump's praise for the Saudi-Turkish-Pakistani defense pact signed in Mecca suggests US alignment with regional defense consolidation efforts. The US is simultaneously pressuring Israel to de-escalate in Gaza and Lebanon while treating Iran as the primary arena, creating a complex diplomatic landscape where regional actors are positioning themselves for multiple contingencies.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Trump administration's use of Iraqi Kurdish President Nechirvan Barzani as a backchannel to IRGC commander Ahmad Vahidi reveals concerns about whether Iranian negotiators truly represent the IRGC's position. Iran's parliament passing legislation criminalizing contact with foreign media, with penalties up to five years imprisonment, suggests tightening internal control amid the conflict. The emergency alert in Saudi Arabia's Jazan region warrants monitoring for potential spillover effects. Nahal Brigade 931's rapid transition from southern Lebanon deployment to northern terrain simulation training suggests the IDF is maintaining readiness for potential northern escalation.
